title: wikicc — Development rules
html:
wikicc — Development rules

These rules bind every commit, not just the ones that change behaviour. They are kept here rather than in README.md so that the product description stays a description of the product: the architecture lives in design.md, the test suite in ../tests/README.md, and the obligations a change has to meet live in this document.

Quality gates

Every commit is expected to leave the quality gates green, and every one of the four has to run locally before committing: a subset — one integration file, only the unit tests, only the front-end suite — does not clear the bar.

cargo fmt --check                          # Rust formatting
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings  # Rust lint
npm run check                              # JS formatting and lint (Biome)
cargo test                                 # everything, including the front-end suite

npm run check covers the reader's own JavaScript — the modules in src/web/js, the tests in tests/js and the scripts in tools, as scoped by biome.jsonc — and fails on a formatting difference, a lint violation or a lint warning; third-party code under node_modules is never touched. npm run format rewrites the formatting in place and npm run lint runs only the lint half. The gates and the suite they protect are described further in ../tests/README.md.

A gate that has to be skipped is a reason not to commit, not a reason to commit with a warning.

The Windows icon

docs/logo.svg is the design source of the executable icon; docs/logo.ico is a derived asset, rendered from it and committed, so that the build needs no image toolchain. After changing the design source, the icon has to be rendered again:

  1. Render docs/logo.svg to square PNGs named logo-<size>.png, with <size> in 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256. Any renderer will do; the sizes have to match exactly.

  2. Pack them into the icon:

    node tools/make-icon.mjs <png-dir> docs/logo.ico
  3. Rebuild. tools/make-icon.mjs refuses a PNG whose size does not match its name, so an incomplete set is caught before the icon is written.

The source and the derived asset must never be committed out of step: a change to docs/logo.svg carries the regenerated docs/logo.ico in the same commit.
